externalTrendSignals.signal: Christian short-form discovery is strongest around bite-sized encouragement, prayer, verse explainers, questions, misconception correction, and story-driven clips.
Short-form is a primary discovery channel for Christian creators, while long-form builds depth and trust.
Search-oriented titles such as 'What does the Bible say about anxiety?' and verse explainers are recommended for YouTube Shorts.
Recent public Christian prayer/video datasets show prayer, blessings, Bible verse, Jesus, hope, and motivation repeatedly appearing in stronger-performing short posts.
sources: SubSub public Christian prayer channel data

rightsSignals.note: Free personal/commercial photo and video use under Pexels license; depicted third-party rights can still matter.
Free use and modification subject to Pixabay Content License and prohibited uses; music can be used as part of larger creative video works.
Some assets use Free License while others use Restricted License. The rights agent must inspect each selected item.
YouTube describes library music/SFX as copyright-safe on YouTube; Creative Commons tracks may require attribution.

ownedChannelSignals.workingHypothesis: Lead with a direct emotional promise/question, keep most Shorts near 22-40 seconds, use moving video, and avoid long text-heavy captions.
